narratives.Description: Build a fixed corpus of spec-to-expected-outcome tasks with automated graders, run as champion-challenger with pinned model and harness across N seeds and pre-registered thresholds. This gates releases rather than commits, and never trusts stored baselines across model changes.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add an eval:run module that executes the golden corpus per model and seed and writes results to the versioned .eval results ledger.
- Add an eval:report command diffing two versions with significance and tests using a small fixture corpus and a rotating holdout.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want a champion-challenger golden-task eval with graders, so that I can gate releases on measured version deltas rather than intuition.
narratives.Traces: #1703 Tier 2; #896 benchmark integrity; depends on Tier 1 grounding and the .eval namespace.

items.title: Corpus run per model and seed

narrative.Acceptance: task eval:run executes the golden corpus per model and seed and stores versioned results.
task eval:report returns metric deltas and significance between two directive versions.
A rotating holdout set validates that gated metrics stay tripwires rather than tuning targets.

expected_outputs: task eval:run golden corpus by model and seed with a results ledger
